name: assembly-newshb-115
summary: Blue-pipe ground machine (15-piece assembly, mirrored about column 59.5): two big round dark-blue pipes run down the screen and bend into a heart-shaped pipe loop on a round grey hard-surface platform, with grille clamps, ribbed canisters, glowing blue lamps, gun ports and lattice towers at the sides.

traits: two parallel straight pipes, columns 33-52 and 67-86
round, constant diameter along the whole run
about as tall as wide (~18 px)
glossy dark blue with a lighter highlight band
features.note: The two main pipes coming down the screen into the top of the loop. Must read as straight cylinders of constant diameter, not chains of bulges or fat capsules with pinched waists.

traits: heart-shaped loop of pipe, two lobes meeting in a dip at the top centre
round tube of constant diameter (~6-7 px)
glossy blue, brighter than the straight pipes
open centre showing the pool
features.note: The pipes bend into this loop at the bottom. It is a tube following a path, thinner than the straight pipes; the inside must stay open (pool and block visible), not swallowed by a fat ring.

traits: elongated oval, about 7x21 px
glowing blue with a near-white hot spot near the top
raised, rounded lens on the pipe's outer side
features.note: Glowing blue lamp on the outer side of each pipe (mirrored at columns 87-96). Emissive, glossy, round-edged.

traits: angular box over the pipe top
grid of 2x3 grey tiles separated by dark recessed grooves
flat top, crisp edges, sits above the pipe
features.note: Grey grille clamp over the top of each pipe (mirrored at columns 71-84). Tiles raised with recessed gaps; hard surface, not rounded.

traits: small grey cylinder lying along the pipe's outer side
alternating light/dark ribs across it (5-6 ribs)
round profile, ribs raised
features.note: Ribbed grey canister on each pipe (mirrored at columns 78-84). Must keep its ribs and read as a separate part beside the pipe, not a texture on it.

traits: two thin vertical masts with nodes, drums and a wide drum/foot
round segments of different widths stacked along the mast
grey metal, mast ~2 px, drums ~5-7 px wide
lean back (drawn tall)
features.note: Tall tower (column 15, rows 1-46) and short tower (column 6, rows 17-50) at each side (mirrored at right). Read as thin masts with stacked drums, not heavy gun barrels or slabs.

traits: dark rectangular opening cut into the platform
light grey raised frame around it
hatch slides from the left (animated)
features.note: Gun port on each side of the loop (mirrored at columns 86-95). Dark recess in a frame, cut in, not painted.

traits: stepped grey block, widening toward the bottom
flat stacked boxes with crisp edges
horizontal ribs on the lower shaft and a centre seam
features.note: Grey block inside the loop running down to the bottom edge. Steps stack upward toward the top; hard surface.

traits: very dark blue-black area inside the loop
lower than the platform and the loop
features.note: Dark pool inside the heart loop, around the stepped block; must stay visible and sunk.

traits: lavender plate on the platform's outer rim
curved outer edge, slopes up inward
flat with horizontal stripes and a bright inner lip
features.note: Lavender side panels of the round platform (mirrored at columns 98-115). Flat bevelled plates, not rounded.

traits: light grey ribbed collar band between rim and loop
vertical ribs/stripes on the collar
diagonal curved step bands at the bottom left
flat plates, crisp edges
features.note: The grey platform round the loop: ribbed collar and curved steps (darker mirror on the right, columns 70-101). Hard surface.

traits: narrow lavender upright block beside the loop
flat, angular
lighter than the side panel
features.note: Lavender post between the lamp and the gun port (mirrored at columns 87-92).

traits: two thin grey rods, 1 px wide, between the pipes
straight, vertical
features.note: Thin rods at columns 54 and 64-65, rows 15-31, in the gap between the pipes.

traits: small dark purple plate at the top edge
angular, flat
features.note: Purple plate reaching in from above beside each pipe (mirrored at columns 86-96).

concept.use: Design guide for shapes and parts; the sprite decides outline, proportions and colours. Cues: two straight constant-diameter pipes with a vertical highlight streak, wrapped by gridded clamp boxes and strap rings, running into one fat heart-shaped manifold tube; blue lights are glowing glass set in dark arched housings; ribbed canisters are coil/disc stacks on a rod; towers are antenna masts of stacked boxes with side knobs; the gap between the pipes is a recessed bay with small pipes and machinery; the deck is flat riveted plating with panel lines; the darker right half is shadow, not a different paint.
